Student Opportunities

Location: Toronto (Onsite)
Duration: Fall (September - December 2026)
Type: Student Full Time
Range: $18.50 - $28.50
Application Deadline: July 3, 2026

About the Opportunity

Our marketing and strategy team is looking for a student to support brand campaign planning, market research, and go-to-market analysis for our digital entertainment products.

Responsibilities

- Support brand marketing campaign planning and creative reviews
- Conduct market research and competitive analysis
- Prepare strategic planning materials for leadership reviews

About Us

Northgate Lottery & Gaming Corporation (NLGC) operates province-wide lottery and gaming entertainment.

Accessibility and Accommodation

We are committed to providing accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodation, please contact Human Resources. Our Human Resources team will work with you to meet your needs.

Privacy Notice

Personal information collected during recruitment is used solely for recruitment purposes and is handled by Human Resources.
